title: Graph: Separate common graph functionalities from IOGraph
description:
Second step in generalizing graphs: create a new `Graph` class containing code that can be common to all kind of graphs and make `IOGraph` inherit from that.

It would be nice to do the same with `IOGraphDialog`, but I don't think that's possible, since it includes the UI element.

Requires and includes !19612. Ping #20298.
